977c25ea81aba734521a.en: The Disease Control Agency (hereinafter referred to as CDC) said on September 22, 2026 that the domestic enterovirus epidemic continues. Because the enterovirus is easy to spread in densely populated and interactive places, such as schools, family planning classes, baby care centers, and indoor children's playgrounds, parents and education and education personnel are reminded to be vigilant, continue to teach young children to develop good personal hygiene habits, strengthen the correct and diligent washing of hands with soap, and implement environmental cleaning and disinfection. During the epidemic, avoid going to crowded public places and implement measures such as resting at home when sick to reduce the risk of transmission. According to the monitoring data of the CDC, the number of outpatient emergency clinic visits for enterovirus in the 37th week (September 13 to September 19) was 10,359, which was the same as the previous week (10,400). It is necessary to observe the change of the epidemic after consecutive holidays. Laboratory surveillance in the past four weeks showed that the community had the most enteroviruses of type A6, followed by Xaqi A6.
